users_role_company_check.name: users_role_company_check
users_role_company_check.value: ("users"."role" = 'super_admin' and "users"."company_id" is null and "users"."is_active") or ("users"."role" in ('admin', 'operator', 'viewer') and "users"."company_id" is not null)

("part_records"."deleted_at" is null and "part_records"."deleted_by_id" is null and "part_records"."deleted_by" is null and "part_records"."deletion_reason" is null and "part_records"."deletion_snapshot" is null)
    or ("part_records"."deleted_at" is not null and "part_records"."deleted_by_id" is not null and "part_records"."deleted_by" is not null and "part_records"."deletion_reason" is not null and "part_records"."deletion_snapshot" is not null)
